requirements.description: Verify a log line is not evidence that another process is ready

requirements.description: Verify a boundary scan must read the code rather than the prose, and must be shown to fire on a mutated module

requirements.description: Verify a timeout that cancels the task it runs in leaves nothing able to record what happened

requirements.description: Verify a refusal that misnames the defect spends the only repair on the wrong correction

requirements.description: Verify a state and the event that explains it, written in two commits, are written event first

requirements.description: Verify a metric read the instant after the call that moved it is read before the scrape that carries it

requirements.description: Verify a checkpoint sealed without naming its own tag cannot be validated from that tag

requirements.description: Verify a payload one service bounds for another must be bounded as the receiver measures it

requirements.description: Verify two processes that meet on a queue must name what crosses it once, and a real run must exercise both

requirements.description: Verify a process sweep that reads what a forking process holds waits on the processes it has to kill

requirements.description: Verify a pre-push check narrower than the change's reach lets a red gate reach the public remote

requirements.description: Verify a contract a model must follow has to reach the model, rendered from the definition the parser enforces

requirements.description: Verify a result is accepted only from the executor that owns the request, decided when the request is created

requirements.description: Verify a pinned lock can become unsafe without changing, so advisory state is live evidence

requirements.description: Verify container health does not prove Docker Desktop host-port forwarding

requirements.description: Verify a lesson exclusion must declare the scope it excludes

requirements.description: Verify parent and child facts without an ORM relationship require an explicit flush boundary

requirements.description: Verify cancellation completion must not bypass cleanup acknowledgement

requirements.description: Verify provenance digests are a set even when their sources are distinct

requirements.description: Verify an identity shared across services must satisfy the strictest persistence type and remain stable

requirements.description: Verify a shared execution resource needs an explicit exclusive owner for every owning domain
